description: This is a backend API module implementing user authentication and profile management endpoints using FastAPI. It includes login, registration, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh functionality for users.

methods.name: login_user( login_data: UserLogin = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, and issuing a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: register_user( user_data: UserCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Registers a new user account, ensuring email and username uniqueness, then issues a JWT token for the new user.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Fetches the profile info of the current user based on the JWT token.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate = Body(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Updates the profile details of the current user using data from the request.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: Issues a new JWT access token for an authenticated user to refresh their session.
